title: Settings → Email: register a new sending domain
journey: Open the web app at https://app.avantej.com
In the Add a sending domain card, enter a unique e2e-test subdomain (e.g. mail-e2e-<ts>.example.com)
Enter 'E2E Test Sender' as the From name
Wait for the success toast 'Domain registered. Add the DNS records and verify.'
Confirm the new row appears in the Sending domains table with status 'pending' and sender 'noreply@<domain>'
